sketch: Weeks 8-9 (base, cont.): easy volume to ~17-18 mi/wk, long run to 6.5-7 mi, Thursday quality_optional continues weekly (tempo option grows to ~15-20 min). Weeks 10-13 (build): add optional race-pace intervals (Option A ~8:30-8:50/mi reps vs. Option B easy), long run grows to 8-9 mi, down week (-30% volume) around wk 12 or 13. Weeks 14-15 (peak): highest volume, peak long run 10-11 mi with race-pace segments, quality stays optional. Week 16 (taper/race wk, Oct 19-25): volume -40-60%, short shakeout runs only, freshness over fitness.
